text:
Elena: Heads-up — starting prod rollout of `release/2026-03-19` in ~5m. Primary checks: SLO dashboards, error-rate, and embedding service 429s. @Abby-Oncall you good to own pager if something noisy shows up? :eyes:

deploy-bot: [deploy started] service-group=frontend,embed-service,router shift=canary -> 30% traffic to v2026-03-19 (id=deploy-1965432199)

Samir: Watching p95/p99 and 5xx panels. Bookmark: https://dash.internal/redwood/s/release-window?view=canary :mag:

monitoring-bot: Preflight checks OK. Canary health: all probes passing. Smoke tests: auth, embed ingestion, prompt-routing ✅

Jess: I'm going to keep the runtime revert playbook handy. If latency p95 > 800ms or 5xx > 1% sustained for 3m, we should roll back. Confirm? :+1:

Taylor: Note — pinned model hash for this rollout is `sha256:3a9f...b2c7` to avoid fallback to the larger fp16 variant. If routing fallback happens, it will bump latency. I'll monitor routing logs.

Abby-Oncall: I got it. Escalation thresholds: error-rate >= 0.5% for 5m -> SEV2 page, error-rate >= 2% for 3m -> SEV1. I'll only page for SEV1 during the window unless it's noisy.

Samir: Seeing a small 429 blip on embed-service canary pods (3x within 1m). Trying quick throttling: `kubectl patch --namespace=embed svc embed-ingest -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'` (testing local patch)

Elena: Good catch. If 429s are from upstream rate limiting, we can shift traffic back to main and short-circuit canary. Decision rule: if 429 spike correlates with p95 lift > 200ms or error-rate lift > 0.3% in 2m, rollback.

monitoring-bot: Canary metrics snapshot at t+4m: p95=290ms (baseline 240ms), error-rate=0.32%, 5xx=0.08%, 429=0.18% (spike localized to embed-service-2 pod).

Ops-bot: Created temporary alert silence on non-actionable noise: alertname="KubePodEvicted" -> muted for 10m during rollout.

Jess: Traffic shift to 50% now per plan. `deploy-bot` command: `/deploy shift deploy-1965432199 50%`

deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 50% (confirmations: 5/5 routers ack)

Samir: After shift, p95=320ms, error-rate=0.6% (embed-service contributed 0.4%). I'm leaning rollback. Symptoms persistent across two minutes and spread across 3 pods.

Taylor: I can roll model back to v2026-03-18 quick patch if we want to avoid full rollback. That would unpin the new kernel changes. It should be faster and less disruptive.

Elena: Call it: partial rollback — pin routing off the new kernel for embed-service and shift traffic back to 10% while we validate Taylor's patch. @deploy-bot run: `/deploy shift deploy-1965432199 10%` and hold. Abby — standby for pages if error-rate > 1% after shift.

deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 10% (5/5 routers). Canary paused.

monitoring-bot: Post-shift snapshot (t+8m): p95=255ms, error-rate=0.15%, 5xx=0.04%, 429=0.05% — trending back toward baseline.

Abby-Oncall: Not paging. I'll keep eyes on alert channel for 10m.

Samir: Patch from Taylor applied to embed-service-canary. Running warmup requests for KV cache.

Jess: Adding quick note to release log: "partial rollback/pinning executed due to embed-service 429s; runtime kernel fallback avoided; revalidated after patch."

Elena: Thanks team. We'll resume gradual ramp when metrics stabilize for 10m. Great coordination. :rocket:
